name: 字符串方法一组
code:
s = '  Hello World  '
t = s.strip()
print(t.upper(), t.lower())
print(t.replace('World', 'Py'))
print(t.find('World'), t.startswith('Hello'), t.endswith('d'))
print(t.split(' '), '-'.join(['a','b']))
print(t.count('l'), t.index('W'))

name: 成员/求和/最值

name: 推导式（含条件/嵌套）
code:
print([x * x for x in range(6)])
print([x for x in range(6) if x % 2 == 0])
print([[y for y in range(x)] for x in range(3)])

z = [x for x in range(3)]
print(x, z)
